description:
Module inside the lernie-ui-egui crate that executes 'lernie <subcommand>' as a subprocess and streams stdout/stderr. Per ARCH §3.4 / §3.5, this is the sole command path from frontend to harness.

=== What to build ===

- Pure-Rust module, no egui/eframe dependency (reusable by future 'lernie-ui-web').
- API: 'Cli::new(lernie_binary: PathBuf) -> Cli' and a method 'run(&self, args: &[&str]) -> impl Stream/Iter<Item = OutputChunk>'.
- Binary resolution: default 'lernie' on PATH; overridable via env var 'LERNIE_BINARY' or explicit arg.
- stdout and stderr streamed chunked, tagged by stream.
- Exit status reported as terminal item in the stream.
- Signal propagation: on drop, SIGTERM then SIGKILL after a short timeout (ARCH §2.9 'Stops are aggressive').

=== Out of scope ===

- Any knowledge of specific lernie subcommands — generic exec wrapper.
- UI wiring.

=== Dependencies ===

- Blocks on bl-1013 (UI skeleton).

=== Testing ===

- Against a shell stub 'fake_lernie' executable on PATH that emits known stdout/stderr patterns and exit codes. Not a mock — a real binary.
- Test signal-on-drop: spawn long-running fake, drop stream, assert child is gone.
- 100% line coverage.
title: UI: CLI outbound module (exec lernie subcommand)
